text:
Ava: Hey team — opened PR to address the p99 latency bump we saw on the canary. small change to connpool backoff and kv-proxy timeouts, plus a safer fallback path. can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4523 :eyes:

Raj: taking a look now, aiming for a review in 20-30m. can you paste the traces you saw?

Ava: pasted a short snippet from the canary traces: 
```
RequestID: c3f9…
p99 latency: 650ms (baseline 180ms)
hotpath: kv-proxy -> connpool Acquire -> wait 240-400ms
Errors: 502 on occasional conn timeouts
```

Olivia: saw same. suspect connpool backoff quadratic retry growth when there are transient N+1 waits. PR toggles a linear backoff + jitter and reduces kv-proxy socket timeout to 250ms. Looks promising but want a perf smoke on canary metrics before merge.

Tim: CI passed on the PR?

deploy-bot: CI status for PR #4523: all checks passed ✅ — unit-tests, integration-tests, canary-smoke.

Mia: quick read-through — code change is small. question: does reducing socket timeout risk increasing 502s for higher tail network jitter?

Ava: yes possible, which is why I added the fallback to a short-term in-memory KV cache for misses (`kv_cache_short_lived`) for 5s to avoid cascading retries. Also added metric flags: `kv.proxy.timeout_rejects` and a feature-guard `slo_fix_canary` so we can flip back immediately.

Raj: left inline comments about a race in Acquire() — small nit but affects correctness under heavy load. I'll push a followup commit to address that and re-run.

Olivia: oncall note — hold merge until the canary has 10 minutes of stable p99 and error-rate within baseline +0.5% (we hit +1.8% during the spike). If followup commit lands, re-run smoke.

Ava: noted. can we schedule a 4pm UTC merge window if smoke looks good? otherwise roll back plan is ready.

Tim: 4pm UTC works for me. I'll be around for rollback if needed.

Raj: pushed fix + rebase. CI triggered.

deploy-bot: CI status for PR #4523 (commit abc123): unit-tests ✅, integration-tests ✅, canary-smoke running.

Olivia: canary metrics (first 5m after new commit): p99 = 190ms, error-rate = +0.2% — stable so far. continue monitoring.

Mia: :thumbsup: looks safe from a quick read. watch for any 502 clusters in logs.

Ava: brilliant — if we keep stable for another 5m I'll submit merge request for the 4pm window. thanks everyone! :heart:

Raj: LGTM from my side after the fix. approve in GH.

Olivia: continuing to monitor the canary dashboard. tagging @oncall for visibility.

deploy-bot: Canary smoke completed: passes. Metric summary: p50=45ms p95=120ms p99=195ms errors +0.2% vs baseline.

Ava: merging into canary branch now, will hold prod merge for 4pm UTC as discussed.

Tim: copy, will be on-standby at 4pm UTC for prod rollout.

Olivia: great job — nice followups and rollback plan.

Raj: thanks — nice quick turnaround.

Ava: Thanks all!
